content: Lekin yeh free NAHI ha ? Or yeh Dekho ham aisi chalaye isse ... pichla agent colab_gpu_bridge_v2.ipynb deta tha: "Runtime -> T4 GPU -> Run dabao, URL mujhe khud mil jayega (ping system hai), so jao"

Free question answered honestly: H3 API is paid (no free clip allowance; 'free tier' = rate limit) and H3 weights need 4xH100 class. Free forever route = Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B (Apache-2.0) on free Colab T4, 480p silent. Built MONARCH_T4_FREE_BRIDGE.ipynb (jobs, Drive receipts, Drive job-queue as the safe 'ping' alternative, tunnel cell OFF by default because Colab TOS forbids server use and this sandbox cannot reach tunnel URLs).

Free route landed: colab/MONARCH_T4_FREE_BRIDGE.ipynb (14 cells, syntax-validated), knowledge/05_FREE_ROUTES.md, data/free_jobs.example.json, 5 new tests (tests total 47 OK), provenance extended; manifest + validate 23 pass 0 errors
